subject: Aurora Analytics — MSA & Order Form: template annotations and billing contacts
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Samir Joshi <samir@aurora-analytics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Aurora Analytics — MSA & Order Form: kickoff, templates, and party details

Hi Samir — great to meet yesterday. Attaching the initial MSA you shared plus the party sheet Aurora sent over. We want to kick off contract review and surface any early non-starters before the demo next Wednesday.

Quick context: Aurora is aiming to onboard a pilot for anomaly detection (20k tokens/day) with a potential committed Dedicated pool if pilot metrics look good. They requested our standard MSA + an order form outlining committed capacity and SLOs.

Ask from Redwood:
- Kimberly, can Legal take first pass on the attached MSA and pull any pricing/penalty language that would block a pilot?
- Connor, please capture IP/data residency flags and confirm whether Private deployment will be recommended for this pilot.
- Samir/Laura, please confirm the entity name on the party sheet and the billing contact for PO issuance — I see "Aurora Analytics, Inc." on the sheet but no billing email.

Attachments: Aurora_MSA_Draft_v1.docx (external redline), Aurora_Party_Sheet.xlsx

Thanks — if we can turn around an annotated draft by EOD Monday that will help Legal & Sales finalize the order form before engineering kickoff.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0147

---
Note: Please treat the attached as confidential.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Samir Joshi <samir@aurora-analytics.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Analytics — MSA & Order Form: kickoff, templates, and party details

Thanks Hannah — looping Legal in. Samir, appreciate the draft. Initial read highlights a few items we need clarified or redlined:

Top priority items (please see inline comments in attached):
1) Data scope and permitted use (Section 2.1): request clarification whether Aurora will send PII or only pseudonymized telemetry. If PII, we need a data processing addendum and specific security controls.
2) Liability cap (Section 9): their proposed uncapped carveouts for indirect damages are broader than our standard. We will propose mutual cap language tied to the order form fees.
3) Audit & logs (Section 7): need to confirm retention window Aurora requires — our default is 90 days for request logs; extensions may impact pricing.
4) IP/Deliverables (Section 5): we will propose language to preserve Redwood model IP and to clearly define customer-owned outputs.

Process proposal:
- I'll produce an annotated PDF/Word with tracked changes by EOD Monday.
- Connor, please confirm data residency/Private deployment feasibility by tomorrow so we can add an explicit deployment clause to the order form.
- Samir/Laura, if you have a security questionnaire or SOC2 evidence to share now it will speed approval — otherwise we can exchange SCP links next week.

Attachments: Aurora_MSA_Draft_v1_redline.docx (Legal annotated draft)

If anything is a hard stop for Aurora on day-one (e.g., required unlimited liability or on-prem air-gapped only), flag it now so Sales can evaluate alternatives.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Joshi <samir@aurora-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Mills <procurement@aurora-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Analytics — MSA & Order Form: kickoff, templates, and party details

Thanks Kimberly and Hannah — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:
- Aurora will be sending telemetry and event metadata only; no direct PII is included in the pilot. We will confirm the exact columns in the party sheet by EOD.
- Billing contact: Laura Mills (procurement@aurora-analytics.com). Entity: Aurora Analytics, Inc.
- Security docs: Laura will upload our vendor security questionnaire and a SOC2 summary to the Drive link you provided by tomorrow.

On liability cap — Aurora prefers commercial cap aligned to fees, but Laura has procurement flexibility for pilot procurements. We'll defer to your proposed language.

Also happy to do a 30-minute contract kickoff call tomorrow 11am PT to walk through the redlines and any non-starters. Let me know if that works.

Regards,
Samir
Samir Joshi
Head of Data Products | Aurora Analytics
